contentList.content: You gain three Rage charges per <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>, which can be used to become enraged. Your subclass determines your type of rage.

Deal [1] additional damage when damaging a non-allied target with <LSTag Tooltip="MeleeWeaponAttack">Melee Weapon Attacks</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Throw_ImprovisedWeapon">Improvised Weapons</LSTag>, and when <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Throw_Throw">Throwing</LSTag> objects or creatures. This passive acts as a replacement of Reckless Attack.

Your attunement with nature and its beasts inspires your rage, empowering you with supernatural might.

A primal anger lingers within your mind, and beasthood threatens to take hold. You gain access to five Bestial Hearts, each of which have unique passive benefits and actions.
Enter a blind fury which channels the ferocity of five Bestial Hearts. Each of your five Bestial Hearts grant a unique action while enraged.

Enter a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE_TOTEM_BEAR">Rage</LSTag> which channels the durability of nature. Affected creature cannot be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="TAUNTED">Goaded</LSTag>.

Upon enraging under one of your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Rage_Totem_Container">Bestial Hearts</LSTag>, you <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DOMINATE_PERSON">Dominate</LSTag> all Beasts and Monstrosities within [1] of you. In addition, upon starting your turn while enraged, you may swap your Beastial Heart without expending a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="Rage">Rage Charge</LSTag>.
Each unique action granted while enraged may now be used with any <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Rage_Totem_Container">Bestial Heart</LSTag>.
While enraged and wearing Light Armour, all damage taken is reduced by your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Strength Modifier</LSTag>.

Upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> while enraged under your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Rage_Totem_Container">Bestial Hearts</LSTag>, your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> increases by 1. This lasts until you are no longer enraged.
Affected creature's <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> is increased by 1 for each stack of this condition. This lasts until they are no longer enraged.
While enraged, allies within [1] of you benefit from the passive effects of your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Rage_Totem_Container">Bestial Hearts</LSTag>.

Violence is both a means and an end. You follow a path of untrammelled fury, slick with blood, as you thrill in the chaos of battle, heedless of your own well-being.

Suggested Role(s): Damage
An uncontrollable ferocity threatens to overtake you, boiling over with pure malice. You gain access to a Frenzy with which to lay bare your pure, destructive wrath.

Lose yourself in anger, giving in to a total <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE_FRENZY">Frenzy</LSTag>! Deal [1] additional damage with <LSTag Tooltip="MeleeWeaponAttack">Melee Weapon Attacks</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Throw_ImprovisedWeapon">Improvised Weapons</LSTag>, and when <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Throw_Throw">Throwing</LSTag> objects or creatures. In addition, your unarmed damage increases.

Affected creature deals an additional [1] damage with Melee Weapon Attacks, Improvised Weapons, and when Throwing objects or creatures.

Additionally, this creature's unarmed damage has increased, and they have Resistance to physical damage, as well as Advantage on Strength based Ability Checks and Saving Throws.
As a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>, throw a character or item from the world or your inventory.

Your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> affects how much weight you can throw. Heavier items deal more damage. The damage of <LSTag Tooltip="Thrown">Thrown Weapons</LSTag> is the same as the weapon's melee damage.
As a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>, make a melee attack with your equipped weapon, rolling with <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>.
When dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore all <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
While <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE_FRENZY">Frenzied</LSTag>, your <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> is doubled.
Upon landing a killing blow while <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE_FRENZY">Frenzied</LSTag>, immediately restore your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>.

Once per turn, your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_FrenziedStrike">Frenzied Strike</LSTag> will deal the maximum damage possible. This effect is reset upon triggering <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_ThrilloftheKill">Thrill of the Kill</LSTag>.

Amidst frigid hilltops and glacial peaks, you have honed your rage, now controlled and enduring.

Suggested Role(s): Control/Damage
Enrage, wreathing yourself in the frigid air where you once tempered your animosity.

Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to all physical damage, <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to Cold damage, and <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> based <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.

Affected creature deals an additional [1] Cold damage with Melee Weapon Attacks, Improvised Weapons, and when Throwing objects or creatures.

Additionally, this creature's unarmed damage has increased, and they have Resistance to physical damage, Immunity to Cold damage, and Advantage on Strength based Ability Checks and Saving Throws.

<LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DIFFICULT_TERRAIN">Difficult Terrain</LSTag> no longer slows you, and you are incapable of slipping on ice. In addition, dealing damage to enemies while enraged will afflict them with one turn of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FROSTBITE">Frigidity</LSTag>.

Upon dealing damage to enemies with a melee based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> while enraged, a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_RayOfFrost">Ray of Frost</LSTag> will fire toward another enemy within [1] of your target.
When dealing damage to an enemy while enraged, you apply one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FROST">Encrusted With Frost</LSTag>.

Upon dealing damage to enemies with a melee based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> while enraged, you deal Cold damage to enemies within [1] of you equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Charisma Modifier</LSTag>.

Upon being damaged by an enemy, you may expend your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag> to retaliate with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Rush_TundralStrike">Tundral Strike</LSTag>, dealing damage to all enemies in a line toward them and inflicting <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHILLED">Chilled</LSTag> for one turn.

Upon being damaged by an enemy, retaliate with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Rush_TundralStrike">Tundral Strike</LSTag>, dealing damage to all enemies in a line toward them and inflicting <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHILLED">Chilled</LSTag> for one turn.
Upon rolling a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, your target will immediately become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FROZEN">Frozen</LSTag>.

You carry the blood of Giants, invoking their might and staggering size alike by drawing strength from the same primordial forces that fuel them.

Suggested Role(s): Damage/Tank
Enrage and drastically increase in both size and musculature.

Affected creature has drastically increased in both size and musculature, improving all their physical capabilities and causing them to, if damaging a non-allied target, deal an additional [1] damage with main-hand Melee Weapon Attacks and while unarmed.

In addition, this creature's unarmed damage has increased, and they have Resistance to physical damage, as well as Advantage on Strength based Ability Checks and Saving Throws.
While enraged, you gain access to <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_BootOfTheGiants">Stormheel</LSTag>.
Brutally kick a creature [1] away from you. Your increased size allows you to move creatures far heavier than what would typically be possible.
While enraged, you gain access to <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Throw_MightyImpel">Mighty Impel</LSTag>.
Pick up and throw a creature or object. Your increased size allows you to move creatures far heavier than what would typically be possible.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> The target cannot be thrown if it is Gargantuan in size.
Upon making a melee based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> while enraged, you deal damage equal to your level in a [1] area. This can be toggled at any time.

While enraged, dealing damage to another creature will always knock them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>. In addition, your <LSTag Tooltip="TwoHanded">Non-Versatile Weapons</LSTag> are now considered <LSTag Tooltip="Versatile">Versatile</LSTag>, allowing you to dual-wield them.
While enraged, all damage rolls are made with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> against creatures that are Large or smaller.

Upon using <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_BootOfTheGiants">Stormheel</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Throw_MightyImpel">Mighty Impel</LSTag> to displace an enemy, they become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GIANT_STAGGERED">Staggered</LSTag>. After Staggering another creature, you are able to immediately dive to their location, smashing your weapon down upon them.
Affected creature is vulnerable to a guaranteed follow-up attack from the Barbarian that applied this status.
Dive toward a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GIANT_STAGGERED">Staggered</LSTag> creature, smashing your weapon down upon them.

Your fury runs unconscionably deep, resting soundly in scars of the past. The briars of that past help you to forge both strength and resilience.

Suggested Role(s): Control/Tank

Enrage, covering yourself in thorns. Enemies who damage you with a melee based Attack Roll will take [1] and receive one stack of Bleed. In addition, while moving, you will leave behind a trail of Spike Growth.

While enraged, both yourself and allies within [2] of you are immune to the effects of both Spike Growth and Difficult Terrain.

Affected creature is covered in thorns, causing them to deal an additional [1] damage with all Melee Weapon Attacks and while unarmed.

In addition, this creature's unarmed damage has increased, and they have Resistance to physical damage, as well as Advantage on Strength based Ability Checks and Saving Throws.

Furthermore, enemies who damage them with a melee based Attack Roll will take [2] and receive one stack of Bleed. While moving, they will leave behind a trail of Spike Growth, and both this creature and allies within [3] of them are immune to the effects of both Spike Growth and Difficult Terrain.
Affected creature is immune to the effects of both Spike Growth and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DIFFICULT_TERRAIN">Difficult Terrain</LSTag>.
Pull a target up to [1] closer to you, causing them to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLEEDING">Bleed</LSTag>.

When an ally within [1] of you is attacked, you may use <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_BloodvineGrasp">Bloodvine Grasp</LSTag> on their aggressor as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag>.

When an ally within [1] of you is attacked, you may use <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_BloodvineGrasp">Bloodvine Grasp</LSTag> on their aggressor as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag>.
Causing an enemy to take damage by falling will deal an additional [1] to both them, as well as all enemies within [2] of them. This damage increases based on your levels in Barbarian.
Erupt in thorns, dealing damage to all nearby enemies.

Upon enraging, create a [1] area of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SpikeGrowth">Spike Growth</LSTag> beneath your feet. In addition, you gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_BloodvineEruption">Bloodvine Eruption</LSTag>.
Pull all nearby enemies up to [1] closer to you, causing them to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLEEDING">Bleed</LSTag>.
Upon ending your turn, you deal [1] to all enemies within [2] of you. This damage increases based on your levels in Barbarian.

The wild influence of magic has transformed you, suffusing you with an arcane power that churns within you, waiting to be released.

Suggested Role(s): Control/Support

A magical energy roils inside of you, ready to erupt. You are able to cast Spells, even while enraged. Additionally, Spells you cast at level one or higher have the potential to trigger a positive surge of <LSTag Tooltip="WildMagic">Wild Magic</LSTag>.

Succumb to a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE_MAGIC">Rage</LSTag> that releases all the magic roiling inside of you. Deal [1] additional damage with Spells, <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="MeleeWeaponAttack">Melee Weapon Attacks</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Throw_ImprovisedWeapon">Improvised Weapons</LSTag>, and when <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Throw_Throw">Throwing</LSTag> objects or creatures. In addition, your unarmed damage increases. This type of Rage allows for you to continue casting Spells.

Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to all elemental damage, and <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> based <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.

Affected creature deals an additional [1] damage with Spells, Cantrip, Melee Weapon Attacks, Improvised Weapons, and when Throwing objects or creatures.

Additionally, this creature's unarmed damage has increased, and they have Resistance to elemental damage, as well as Advantage on Strength based Ability Checks and Saving Throws.

Spells may continue to be cast during this type of Rage, and will potentially trigger a positive surge of Wild Magic when cast at level one or higher.

Upon Enraging, you immediately experience a barbarous surge of Wild Magic. Your fury malforms the weave within, causing alterations within the surge that lead to new and unique effects.

When damaged, your aggressor may instead experience a negative surge of Wild Magic.
Upon landing a killing blow, you recover a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag> of the highest level you can cast based on your levels in Barbarian.

Upon landing a killing blow, you immediately experience a positive surge of <LSTag Tooltip="WildMagic">Wild Magic</LSTag>. Additionally, upon rolling a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, your target immediately experiences a negative surge of Wild Magic. These effects can trigger once per turn.
Upon <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE_MAGIC">Enraging</LSTag>, all allies within [1] of you immediately experience a positive surge of <LSTag Tooltip="WildMagic">Wild Magic</LSTag>.
Upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, you may cast a Spell as a free action. This effect can trigger once per turn.
Affected creature may cast a Spell as a free action.

Your ferocity in battle exudes a potent air of death.
An abject horror to all who would behold you.
While enraged, gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on all damage rolls.
Upon rolling a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, roll an additional damage die.
Gain the ability to forcibly succeed any <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> at the cost of one of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="Rage">Rage Charges</LSTag>.
Use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag> to potentially <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INTIMIDATING_PRESENCE">Intimidate</LSTag> a target.
